description: Every action (activity event: type, record id, source, time) performed with one API token, newest first, 50 per page (pass `cursor` from `next_cursor`). Together with get_credential it answers "what could this token reach, and what did it do". Works for revoked tokens. Admin only. [Full notes: get_started section "TOOL NOTES list_credential_actions"]
name: list_credential_actions
title: List what one credential did
